leaves.name: picLocFinType
leaves.doc: pic-dict: a scheme representing Pic_{A/K} of an abelian variety A over a field K is locally of finite type (Murre 1964 / Oort 1962, BLR, Neron models, 8.2 Thm 3: Pic_{X/k} exists and is locally of finite type for X proper over a field; also Kleiman, The Picard scheme, Thm 9.4.8 for X projective, A being projective by the vendored GrpObj.exists_isImmersion_projectiveSpace_of_smooth_of_geometricallyIntegral; any representing object by Yoneda; locators UNVERIFIED).
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (BLR 8.2 Thm 3 / Murre-Oort for proper X over a field; Kleiman 9.4.8 for projective X, A projective by the vendored lemma; any representing object by Yoneda uniqueness); locator UNVERIFIED
leaves.source: BLR, Neron models, 8.2 Thm 3 (Murre 1964, Oort 1962); Kleiman, The Picard scheme, 9.4.8

leaves.name: identityComponentLFT
leaves.doc: pic-dict: the identity component of a group scheme locally of finite type over a field is an open, geometrically irreducible subgroup (SGA 3 VI_A 2.4; Stacks 0B7R; locators UNVERIFIED).
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf; locator UNVERIFIED

leaves.name: picZeroSmoothPosChar
leaves.doc: pic-smooth: the identity component of Pic_{A/K} is smooth over K for A an abelian variety over a field K of characteristic p > 0 (PicDict.PicZeroSmooth restricted to positive characteristic, a consequence of it; characteristic 0 is proved from Cartier's theorem and PicLocFinType in PicSmooth.picZeroSmooth_of_cartier). Mumford 13 over Kbar with the identification of the dual with the fppf Pic0 and descent; one print over an arbitrary field pending reading: BLR 8.4, FGA Explained 9.5, Milne 1986 10; locators UNVERIFIED.
leaves.flag: pending reading: positive-characteristic case only (char 0 proved via Cartier, cartierSmooth_proof); one print over an arbitrary field of characteristic p not located (Mumford 13 is over Kbar and about Mumford's dual, not the fppf Pic0; BLR 8.4 / FGA Explained 9.5 / Milne 1986 10 to read); locator UNVERIFIED
leaves.source: Mumford, Abelian varieties, 13 (over Kbar); BLR 8.4; Milne 1986 10

leaves.name: kleimanPicZeroProper
leaves.doc: pic-fix: for X proper and geometrically normal over a field K, the identity component of Pic_{X/K} is proper (Kleiman, The Picard scheme, Thm 9.5.4; locator UNVERIFIED); stated for every representing scheme.
